access_note: Restricted product: sales and renewals only to existing customers; academic edition on request.
description: Riverbed Modeler, formerly OPNET Modeler, is a commercial discrete-event simulator for modelling and analysing communication networks and distributed systems. It simulates network types and technologies such as VoIP, TCP, OSPFv3, MPLS, LTE, WLAN, IoT protocols and IPv6, supports parallel and distributed simulation, provides charts and visualisation, and ships more than 400 protocol and vendor device models; wireless and defence suites extended it to radio and military networks. OPNET Technologies developed it from the late 1980s, Riverbed acquired OPNET in 2012, and the last documented release is 18.10. Riverbed has moved the product to its restricted product list: purchases and renewals are limited to existing customers, with renewals of at most one year, and a University Modeler edition can be requested by academic institutions. Coverage: user-built enterprise, carrier and defence networks without geographic data. Format and access: Windows desktop software with a GUI and a C/C++ process-model editor; paid under a proprietary licence. Caveats: effectively discontinued for new customers; many published studies used academic editions that are no longer easy to obtain; results rely on vendor models that are not public. Simulation uses: capacity planning, network flow and resilience studies of enterprise and carrier networks, and reproducing earlier OPNET-based studies. Related records: Keysight EXata and QualNet and NetSim are active commercial alternatives; ns-3 and OMNeT++ are open alternatives.
